description: This Java class 'ReportReader' reads and processes report data from a file. It includes methods for reading data, filtering invalid entries, transforming data into nested maps, and logging range statistics. The class is designed for parsing a specific report format using regex pattern matching and handles report lines encapsulated in 'ReportLine' objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, initiates reading a specific report file.

methods.name: readMap
methods.description: Reads a report file by filename, filters and converts the data into a map structure grouped by RPM and MAF values.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Transforms a list of ReportLine objects into a nested map organized by RPM and MAF values.

methods.name: findMinMax
methods.description: Calculates and logs the minimum and maximum values for MAF and RPM among the provided report lines.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters out report lines with invalid RPM differences, logging relevant statistics.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads lines from a specified file and parses them into ReportLine objects.

methods.name: handleOneLine
methods.description: Parses a single line of report text into a ReportLine object, matching a predefined pattern and filtering out duplicates.
